questions.instructions: Can request-controlled input change executable database query syntax or selector operators on a supported path? Choose vulnerable only when the supplied source, verified library contract and relevant guard/path evidence establish that property. Choose protected for verified separation (bound SQL data, constrained scalar selectors, or effective context-specific conversions/filters); poor construction practice alone is not injection. Choose unknown for missing source, API, guard or necessary path facts. Choose not_applicable only if this is not an injection-sensitive use. For protected, establish protection on ALL feasible input paths, not merely one branch. Evaluate every output alternative: a verified Number result or numeric literal cannot carry arbitrary input text into an expression; if all alternatives have that constraint, the conditional does not introduce a raw-text bypass. A Number conversion in one ternary branch does not constrain an unconverted sibling branch. Truncation or newline removal alone does not exclude query operators/calls; assess other alternatives without borrowing the numeric guarantee. Evaluate the actual operation and slot, not category labels or source comments. Fields: password, username. Target source comments, challenge names and annotations are not evidence of the expected result.
